title: Variety records: vegetables (e.g. tomato, onion, cabbage) (open sources)
context: vegetables (e.g. tomato, onion, cabbage) are important crops with openly-documented varieties in gene banks and public catalogs.
objective: Compile documented variety records for vegetables (e.g. tomato, onion, cabbage) from open sources, following the schema with a citation and license per record.
acceptanceCriteria: >=15 records across >=2 vegetables (e.g. tomato, onion, cabbage), each with source + license
No proprietary catalogs or agronomic advice
